trailhead.label: Vnà, by the Jalmèr PostBus stop, the board’s start

cautions: A descent of 174 m into Val Sinestra: take it slowly with older dogs.
A short stretch on the road at the end of the valley: lead short.
Cows may graze the meadows above Vnà: lead short and go round the herd.
No water point is listed on this walk: carry enough for you and your dog.
Follow local signs, lead rules and temporary closures.

emergency.note: Call the European emergency number when urgent help is required. Connectivity is not guaranteed.
